description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You roll Gun Failure (§3) while an enemy is adjacent to you.

If it is going to fail anyway, it may as well fail toward someone.

Direct the failure outward. The Gun Failure result affects the adjacent enemy instead of you or your weapon wherever it plausibly can — Kickback shoves it, Scorched Hand burns it, Deafening Bang deafens it and not you. Results that only affect the weapon itself, including Blow Up, still land on the weapon, and Blow Up still catches everyone nearby.

cinderfall.incomplete: redirects a homebrew table result onto a different creature; no selector for any part of this. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
